evidence.title: GitHub - lassejlv/termy: The terminal, at full speed

name: Termy
summary: GPU-accelerated terminal for macOS, Linux and Windows with tabs, splits, a command palette and plugins.
description: Termy is a native terminal for macOS, Linux and Windows built on its own streaming parser and damage-scoped GPU rendering. It ships tabs, split panes, scrollback search, a command palette, themes and keybindings in a plain config file, tasks and reusable layouts, plugins, saved SSH hosts and optional tmux sessions. The Rust core (libtermy) can be embedded in native hosts, and @termysh packages run the engine in the browser.
contains: native terminal for macOS, Linux and Windows
damage-scoped GPU rendering with dirty-span cell caching
tabs, split panes, scrollback search, tasks and reusable layouts
command palette, themes and keybindings via a config file
plugin system with palette commands and native UI
optional tmux control-mode sessions and saved SSH hosts
libtermy embeddable in Rust/C/Swift; @termysh web packages
